J’ai trouvé cette boîte de chocolats en promotion chez Action, et on a décidé de la tester 🍫 Dans cette boîte, il y a 10 chocolats différents, chacun avec une forme et un goût uniques — aucun ne se répète, ce qui rend la dégustation encore plus intéressante. Nous avons ouvert la boîte et tout goûté, et honnêtement, les chocolats nous ont beaucoup plu : bonne texture, saveurs agréables, et une belle présentation. Le seul point négatif, c’est le prix : la boîte ne fait que 100 grammes, et sans promotion, ces chocolats sont clairement un peu chers. Avec la réduction, le rapport qualité-prix devient correct, mais à plein tarif, c’est plutôt un chocolat plaisir occasionnel. 👉 Notre avis complet et la dégustation sont à voir dans la vidéo. #Action  #chocolat  #lifestyle  #testproduit  #avis

I realized I never gave ya’ll the recipe to my BigBrownieChunks or bbc recipe so…here ya go! So gooey!  🍫Pan: 8×8-inch light metal pan Oven: 350°F Ingredients: * 1 cup (226 g) unsalted butter * 1⅓ cups (120 g) Dutch-processed cocoa powder * 1 teaspoon fine sea salt * 2½ cups powdered sugar * ½ cup light brown sugar * 3 large eggs, room temperature * 1 additional egg yolk, room temperature * 3 teaspoons vanilla extract * 1 cup (120 g) all-purpose flour * 1½ cups (280 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips * ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar * Powdered sugar, for finishing Step-by-Step 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line an 8×8-inch light metal pan with parchment paper. 2. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Continue cooking, stirring frequently, until it becomes golden brown, smells nutty, and you can see browned milk solids at the bottom. 3. Add the cocoa powder and salt to a heat safe bowl. Immediately pour the hot browned butter over the cocoa and whisk or stir until completely smooth and glossy. Let cool until warm, not hot. 4. Whisk the sugars & eggs for that crackle top! In a separate large bowl, combine the powdered sugar, brown sugar, 3 eggs, and additional egg yolk. Whisk HARD for 60–90 seconds, until the mixture looks lighter, thick, glossy, and well combined. 5. Stir the vanilla into the warm cocoa butter mixture. Pour the cocoa mixture into the egg & sugar mixture and whisk until the batter is thick, dark, smooth, and shiny. 6. Gently fold in the flour just until the last dry streak disappears. Do not overmix. 7. Reserve 1/4 cup of batter for extra crackle top! set it aside. 8. Gently fold 1½ cups semi-sweet chocolate chips into the remaining batter. Spread the chocolate-chip brownie batter evenly into the prepared pan. 9. Make the smooth crackle layer Take the reserved ¼ cup of chip-free batter and spread it very thinly over the surface. 10. Sprinkle the ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar over the top. These will melt into gooey chocolate pockets. 11. Bake at 350°F for 28–35 minutes. Don’t wait for a completely clean toothpick! the brownies are supposed to stay molten and fudgy inside. 12. Let the brownies cool completely in the pan before lifting them out. #brownies #brownierecipe #molten #chocolate

videos.caption: I just wanted to bake chocolate lava cakes... Instead Evelyn cracked me, in more way than one. 🥀🍫😭 #househusbandbakes #evelynchevalier #evelynzzz #animecouplegoals #animetok  This recipe makes 4 chocolate lava cakes.  Ingredients:  • 1/2 cup (4 ounces) unsalted butter, plus more for greasing the ramekins • 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting the ramekins • 6 ounces bittersweet or dark chocolate, chopped (about 1 cup plus 1 1/2 tablespoons) You can sub in chocolate chips if its all you have. • 2 large eggs, room temperature • 2 large egg yolks, room temperature • 1/4 cup granulated sugar • 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt Directions:  Gather the ingredients. ● Preheat oven to 450°F. Butter and lightly flour four 6-ounce ramekins. Tap out excess flour. Set the ramekins on a baking sheet. ● Fill a pan/pot with water to a depth of 1 or 2 Inches depending on the depth of the pot; bring to a boil over medium-high and reduce heat to medium-low to maintain a simmer. Combine chocolate and butter in a medium size heatproof bowl and set bowl over simmering water in pan, making sure bottom of bowl doesn't touch water. Cook over medium-low, stirring occasionally and adjusting heat as needed to maintain a simmer, until chocolate mixture is melted and smooth, 10 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. ● Beat eggs, egg yolks, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl with an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment on high speed until thickened and pale, 2 to 3 minutes ● Whisk melted chocolate until smooth ● Quickly fold melted chocolate mixture and flour into egg mixture in bowl until well combined and no streaks remain. ● Spoon batter into prepared ramekins (about 1/2 cup per ramekin) and smooth the top using a small offset spatula if needed. Place baking sheet with ramekins in the preheated oven; bake until tops of cakes are just set and edges spring back when touched but centers still feel soft, about 9 to 12 minutes. ● Remove cakes from oven and let cool in ramekins on baking sheet for 1 minute. Working with one ramekin at a time, cover ramekin with an inverted plate. Carefully turn over and let stand 10 seconds before lifting the ramekin to unmold cake. Repeat with remaining cakes. Dust with powdered sugar if you want the dominos pizza lavs cake look. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 days. Microwave briefly to reheat.
